RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.title: Imbued Teacup
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.description: The first rune you [gold]Inscribe[/gold] each turn has its values doubled.
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED_TEACUP.flavor: Steeped so long the leaves began to hum.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.title: Enchanted Anvil
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.description: Whenever you [gold]Inscribe[/gold], deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_ANVIL.flavor: Every stroke rings like a hammer blow.
RUNEPRIEST-BAPTISED_IDOL.title: Baptised Idol
RUNEPRIEST-BAPTISED_IDOL.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards} random cards that [gold]Inscribe[/gold] runes.
RUNEPRIEST-MIDAS_HAND.title: Midas Hand
RUNEPRIEST-MIDAS_HAND.flavor: It writes in a very expensive ink.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNIC_SPHERE.title: Runic Sphere
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_SPARKLER.title: Holy Sparkler
RUNEPRIEST-HOLY_SPARKLER.flavor: Every misfire still makes a pretty light.
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.title: Blessed Toolbox
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.description: Upon pickup, add a random Common card with Rune in its name to your deck. The first time you play a rune card each combat, draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
RUNEPRIEST-BLESSED_TOOLBOX.flavor: Every chisel inside has been blessed. Twice, to be safe.
RUNEPRIEST-AETHER_INKWELL.title: Aether Inkwell
RUNEPRIEST-AETHER_INKWELL.flavor: The ink never dries, and neither do the runes it writes.
